title: Taskelith review route evaluation line
description: One line of the offline route evaluation's evaluation.jsonl: an archived change with review records, its features as of the revision named by the branch's first "pass 1" commit, the rule and shadow decisions on those features, and the review outcome. It reuses definitions of the route schema, urn:taskelith:review-route, and the finding schema, urn:taskelith:review-finding. Unknown properties are rejected, and no property holds free text.

mergeCommit.description: Full SHA of the pull request merge that brought the archived change into dev.

devCommit.description: Full SHA of the dev commit that the features were diffed against and the capability history was read at.

reviewedCommit.description: Full SHA of the revision that the features describe: the parent of the earliest branch commit whose subject names pass 1, or the merge commit when approximate.

approximate.description: True when no branch commit names pass 1, so the features come from the merged diff, which review fixes enlarge.

outcome.description: The review outcome from the archived findings.jsonl and passes.jsonl.

passesNeeded.description: The highest recorded pass, at least 1; a lower bound when passSummaries is false, because passes without findings were then not recorded.

severityCounts.description: Number of the pass's findings per severity.
